records.text: Adrienne Adams said her first foreign visit as mayor would be to the Holy Land.
records.speaker: Adrienne Adams

appearances.snippet: First visit? I would visit the Holy Land.

verification.notes: The source appearance is a clip from the June 12, 2025 Democratic mayoral debate. In response to the moderator asking where each candidate would make a first foreign visit as mayor, Adrienne Adams answered that she would visit the Holy Land. The full-debate publication identifies Adams as a participant and provides the primary video.
